Daily Devotional

December 22

40 How oft did they provoke him in the wilderness, and grieve him in the desert! 41 Yea, they turned back and tempted God, and limited the Holy One of Israel. (Psalms 78:40-41)

This is speaking of how often that the Jews provoked God in the wilderness, and grieved Him in the desert. If you recall, after Moses had led the Jews out of Egypt, by God sending spectacular miracles, it wasn’t but a few days before the Jews started complaining and griping about everything. God was leading them in a cloud by day and fire by night, and yet even though they had the very presence of God with them, they just kept on griping, and it grieved God greatly, that His children were so discontent and unthankful. If it weren’t for Moses interceding for them (Exodus 32:11-14), God would have totally destroyed them. Us Christians need to be very careful to not mummer and complain all the time like the Jews did. One of the signs of the end time is that we become unthankful (2 Timothy 3:1-2), and the world sure is there now. We need to thank God everyday for all His blessings, and not complain all the time. Get to know God better, and know His love (1 John 4:8), and you can’t help but be thankful.

The Jews refused to enter the Promised Land, after God brought them to the border of it. Even though they had seen the marvelous power of God demonstrated in Egypt, and He had promised to give them the land, they became afraid and refused to go in and conquer it. It is truly amazing that we humans can limit God, as this verse says. But because He has given dominion of this earth to us humans (Genesis 1:28), God has to work through us humans to accomplish His will, so that means that we have to cooperate with Him, or we limit Him. So many people think that God can just do anything He wants, but He has limited Himself to working through us, and that means that we do limit God when we don’t follow His leading. This sure does show that the “sovereignty of God” doctrine is untrue, as they say that God just controls everything that happens. They teach that nothing happens without His approval – Not true, and it is blasphemy against the Holy Ghost (Matthew 12:31-32). Wow, what power God has given us, and we need to use it for the glory of God in all we do. Thank you Lord for giving us dominion over this earth – Praise God!
